body: U+0023# Manual-test build installed on the owner's Note10+ (2026-10-01)U+000AU+000AU+002D At the owner's request, installed `dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.plain` (profile build of PR #247 head 18492bd, apps/manual-18492bd/plain-profile.apk) on the Note10+ and seeded its journal: 2025 all 365 days, 2026 from Jan 1 to Sep 30 (273 days); today left empty.U+000AU+002D Seeding is repeatable with `testkit/bin/phone_install_seeded.zsh U+003Capk> work/postmerge/seed2025.sql work/postmerge/seed2026-to-date.sql`.U+000A  U+002D It uses `run-as`, which works because profile builds are debuggable.U+000A  U+002D A release build made debuggable silently becomes a debug (JIT) Flutter build: FlutterPluginUtils.buildModeFor checks the build type's isDebuggable before falling back to release.U+000AU+002D The real app `dev.satanshumishra.field_notes` was not installed, before or after.U+000AU+002D Remove the plain app when the owner is done: `adb -s RF8MA2NA3ZM uninstall dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.plain`.
